title: Articles: A or An?

vocab.ex: There is a bakery on the corner.
I live in a quiet neighbourhood.
Use an before a vowel sound.
Use a before a consonant sound.
Take an umbrella, it is raining.
A book means one book, not a specific one.
An hour has a silent h.
It's about sound, not spelling: a university.
We bought a house last year.
He wears a uniform at work.
We saw an elephant at the zoo.

expressions.example: I need a couple of minutes.

expressions.expr: an idea popped into my head
expressions.meaning: uma ideia surgiu na minha cabeça
expressions.example: An idea popped into my head during the meeting.
She has an eye for detail.

sentences: He waited for an hour at the airport.
We saw an elephant at the zoo.
She studies at a university in Lisbon.
He is an honest and hardworking person.
Can you give me an example?

grammar.title: A ou An: Artigo Indefinido
rules: Use a antes de som de consoante: a car, a house, a university.
Use an antes de som de vogal: an apple, an hour, an umbrella.
A regra é sobre o SOM, não a letra: 'university' começa com som de 'y' (consoante), então usa a.
Palavras com h mudo usam an: an hour, an honest person.

quiz.q: We saw ___ elephant at the zoo.

speak: He waited for an hour at the airport.
She studies at a university in Lisbon.
